title: 0 A.D. (video game)
summary: 0 A.D. is a free, open-source real-time strategy game set between 500 BC and 1 BC, built on the Pyrogenesis engine and cross-platform. Players manage base-building, economy, army training, and technology research across evolving settlement phases. Multiplayer uses peer-to-peer networking. Development shifted from an Age of Kings mod to a standalone project, with historical accuracy prioritized for unit and building design. Funding is primarily handled by Software in the Public Interest.

mechanisms.title: Pyrogenesis engine architecture
mechanisms.explanation: The game runs on the in-house Pyrogenesis engine, written primarily in C++ with JavaScript components, handling rendering, simulation, and systems integration for real-time strategy gameplay.

mechanisms.title: Peer-to-peer multiplayer networking
mechanisms.explanation: Multiplayer functionality is implemented using peer-to-peer networking, eliminating the need for a central server and relying on direct player connections.
